name: WooCommerce Product Ajax Search – with live Filter
author: aiPlugins

sections.description:
Swift Search is a fast and powerful WooCommerce search plugin that replaces the default WordPress search with an instant, smart, AJAX-powered solution. Built specifically for WooCommerce stores, Swift Search delivers accurate product search results, real-time suggestions, and advanced filtering capabilities.

Key benefits:

  • Faster Product Discovery: AJAX-based live search delivers results instantly.
  • Smarter Results: Advanced search algorithms return highly relevant WooCommerce product results.
  • Customizable Forms: Create unlimited search forms tailored to your store.
  • Easy Integration: Use widgets or shortcodes to place search bars anywhere.
  • Boost Conversions: Help customers find what they want—faster.

Key Features

  • AJAX WooCommerce Search: Live product search with real-time result display.
  • Search by Product SKU: Let customers search by SKU or variation ID (Pro Feature).
  • Advanced Product Filters: Filter by category, price, stock, rating, tags (Pro Feature).
  • Exclude Specific Content: Hide categories, out-of-stock products, or post types.
  • Smart Highlighting: Highlights search terms in results to increase engagement.
  • Multilingual Support: Compatible with WPML, Polylang, and Weglot.
  • Search Analytics: View top search queries and improve product listings (Pro Feature).
  • Custom Post Type Support: Search beyond WooCommerce—pages, posts, attachments.

Search Content Types

Swift Search gives you total control over what content users can search, with full WooCommerce search support.

  • WooCommerce Products: Titles, descriptions, categories, SKUs, attributes (Pro Feature).
  • Product Variations: Include variations in search (Pro Feature).
  • Custom Post Types: Enable search for posts, pages, or custom content.
  • Attachments: Search images, documents, and product-related media (Pro Feature).
  • Exclude Unwanted Results: Limit search scope by product stock, category, or tags.

Optimized for WooCommerce Product Search

Swift Search transforms your WooCommerce store’s product search into a high-performance experience. Improve user satisfaction and conversions by giving customers exactly what they want—instantly.

  • Live Search for Products: Find products as you type—no page reloads.
  • Dynamic Filtering: Let users refine results by attribute, price, rating, or category.
  • SKU and Attribute Search: Powerful backend logic to search by product metadata.
  • Display Controls: Choose grid, list, or custom result templates.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/swift-search or install via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Go to Swift Search > Settings to customize search options.
  4. Add the search widget or use shortcode [swift_search_form] to display the search form.
sections.faq:
Q: Is this plugin optimized for WooCommerce?
Yes, Swift Search is built for WooCommerce and offers powerful product search capabilities including SKU, variation, and attribute search.

Q: Can I control what content is searchable?
Absolutely. You can include or exclude WooCommerce products, posts, pages, custom post types, or out-of-stock items.

Q: Does it support live/AJAX search?
Yes, live AJAX product search is a core feature of Swift Search.

Q: How do I add the search bar to my site?
Use the widget, shortcode, or PHP function to insert the search form anywhere.

Q: Is there a Pro version?
Yes, Swift Search Pro unlocks advanced features like SKU search, variation support, filters, analytics, and more.
